title: RankCert: When Can Simulated Learners Safely Select an AI Tutor? Robust Decision Certification Under Structural Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2609.26069v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Simulation-based tutor selection can be unstable when predictively adequate learner models imply different policy rankings. RankCert certifies one of eight equal-budget tutoring policies only when model-averaged utility, probability-best, posterior regret, cross-domain rank, family coverage, and leave-one-domain-out and leave-one-visible-family-out averages support the same candidate; otherwise it abstains. We evaluated RankCert in 1,280 frozen held-out settings spanning five rotating held-out oracle families, 64 scenarios per family, and four cohort sizes. Calibration used a licensed, de-identified EdNet-KT1 derivative with 5,000 learners and 590,056 retained responses; all five family representatives passed the frozen adequacy gate. Minimum-domain mean pairwise top-1 agreement was 0.272917 (95% CI [0.253646, 0.293229]), showing substantial structural disagreement. translated_abstract: 当预测性能充分的学习者模型暗示不同的策略排序时，基于仿真的导师选择可能不稳定。RankCert仅在模型平均效用、概率最优、后验遗憾、跨域排名、族覆盖以及留一域和留一可见族的平均值均支持同一候选者时，才认证八种等预算辅导策略中的一种；否则它将弃权。我们在1,280个冻结的保留设置中评估了RankCert，涵盖五个轮换的保留oracle族、每个族64个场景以及四种队列规模。校准使用了经过许可的、去标识化的EdNet-KT1衍生数据集，包含5,000名学习者和590,056条保留的响应；所有五个族代表均通过了冻结的充分性门槛。最小域的平均成对top-1一致性为0.272917（95% CI [0.253646, 0.293229]），显示出显著的结构性分歧。队列噪声方差从n=30到n=300有所下降，而stru（摘要原文不完整）
tldr: RankCert提出了一种鲁棒的决策认证框架，只有当模型平均效用、后验遗憾和跨域排名等多种指标一致支持同一AI导师候选时才进行认证，否则弃权，从而在结构不确定性下实现安全的AI导师选择。
en_tdlr: RankCert proposes a robust decision certification framework that certifies an AI tutor only when model-averaged utility, posterior regret, and cross-domain rank metrics unanimously support the same candidate and abstains otherwise, enabling safe AI tutor selection under structural uncertainty.
